description: A compile-time contract (`interface Notifier`). TypeScript checks shapes structurally, so any object with the right members satisfies it.
Interchangeable implementations of one interface, selected at runtime (by channel, provider, country) instead of an `if/else` chain.
Add behavior by adding code (a new class), not by editing a working core (another `case` in a switch).
Every implementation must honor the contract: same return types, same error behavior. A fake that behaves differently lies to your tests.
`constructor(private readonly transport: Transport) {}` declares and assigns a field in one step.
Combine objects by passing them in rather than extending classes; avoids fragile base classes.
